inputs.text: The R20.56 million allegation is serious, but it is not proof that Terry Pheto did anything wrong. The bigger issue is whether the National Lotteries Commission’s oversight systems are strong enough to ensure public money reaches the communities it is meant to serve. The briefing to Parliament’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, should lead to real scrutiny of those systems—not a convenient focus on one public figure while institutional failures go unexamined. The SIU probe must establish what happened and who was responsible. Communities deserve transparency and accountability, not just assurances.
